insights.text: Their best players are jungle and support: **Señor Flausch** (Master 648 LP) and **Lord Steve** (Master 1,071 LP). Our bans go on Flausch.
Mid is their weak link: **WoFu Ven** is Diamond 2, 14-16 in his last 30 ranked games, and plays immobile control mages (Anivia, Viktor, Xerath, Ziggs, Veigar). Smette's first gank goes mid.
They win fast and lose long: their 8 wins took 29 min on average, their 7 losses 36 min (three of them 42+ min). Don't take early coin-flips; we're fine at 3 items.
Other teams banned **Elise** (8×) and **Jarvan IV** (5×) against them. Both are Flausch's champions, so we do the same.
They ban **Darius** (5×), **Sett** (4×) and **Sylas** (3×) themselves. Expect Sylas gone for Heino. If Darius or Sett are ever open, Kolbe takes them.

phase1.why: Flausch's most played Prime League jungler (4-2) and 6-3 in solo queue. Also LEC Summer's most picked jungler.
Don's carry in their best comp: 2-0, going 16/2 and 13/2. 691k mastery.
Flausch's best solo queue champ (7-2). Banned against them in 8 of their 15 Prime League games.

phase2.why: If Flausch hasn't picked yet: 2-0 in Prime League, 5-1 in solo queue.
If Ruvex's top isn't out yet: 3-0 for him in Prime League.
Ruvex's most played Prime League top (3-2), 328k mastery.
WoFu's most played Prime League mid (2-1) and the mage that annoys Heino's assassins most.

bans.expect: Against us, teams banned Shaco (5×), Ekko, Katarina and LeBlanc (3× each). BS eSports bans Sylas often. Plan Heino's mid with Ahri, Lissandra and Qiyana as backups.

roles.about: Diamond 4. Prime League: K'Sante 3-2, Ambessa 3-0, Ornn 2-1. Solo queue: Yone 9-2, Ambessa 3-6.

picks.why: LEC Summer's most picked top (36 games, 61% WR). AP damage that kites K'Sante and Ornn; Equalizer wins teamfights. Plays like a mage, close to Kolbe's Viktor/Ryze.
Kolbe comfort (368k mastery). Subjugate deletes K'Sante's and Ornn's tankiness, the pillar stops Ambessa and Yone dashes. 67% WR in LEC Summer.
Safest blind pick. His ult turns Smette's ganks and bot dives into 2v1s or 3v2s. LEC Summer staple (24 games, 58% WR).
Most banned champ of LEC Summer. Ranged lane bully against Ruvex's melee picks; only if Kolbe has some games on him.
Kolbe's highest mastery (1.18M). Flex teamfight pick if they go two AP threats; weak in lane against Ambessa or Yone.

roles.tip: Kolbe picks last on both sides: he's the flexible one, so he gets the counterpick. If Darius or Sett are open, take them: his team bans them often (Darius in 5 of 15 games, Sett in 4).

roles.about: Master 648 LP, their carry. Prime League: Jarvan IV 4-2, Xin Zhao 2-0, Vi 1-1, Wukong 1-1, Lee Sin 0-2. Solo queue: Elise 7-2, Jarvan IV 6-3, Xin Zhao 5-1.

picks.why: 3-0 for Smette in our Prime League games. His ult chains with Shen, Nautilus and Lissandra.
Take it first to deny Flausch his next-best champion. Strong early 1v1, LEC Spring's most picked jungler.
Smette's main right now (17 ranked games, 10 wins). Resets in long fights, which fits the scaling plan.
Point-and-click lock on their immobile mid and ADC. High pro priority in LEC Summer (24 picks, 55 bans).

roles.tip: Don't 1v1 Flausch early, he's 1,000+ LP ahead. Ward your raptors/blue entrance by 1:15, ping where he starts, and play for mid and bot prio instead of invading.

roles.about: Diamond 2, their lowest rank. Prime League: Anivia 2-1, Viktor 1-2, Xerath, Diana, Ziggs, Veigar and Akali 1-0 each. Solo queue: Yasuo, Cassiopeia, Anivia.

picks.why: Heino's best right now (6 ranked games, 6 wins). Dashes onto immobile mages and dodges Anivia/Viktor CC. Often banned against us, so have a backup.
22/3/8 in our last Prime League game with her. Safe blind pick, charm for catches, pro-viable.
KDA 17 in her last ranked game. The engage for comp C, and a counter to Akali, Diana and Yasuo.
Heino's highest mastery (558k). Punishes Viktor, Syndra, Xerath, Ziggs and Veigar.
Pro-viable assassin (picked in the LEC Summer playoffs). All-in on immobile mages, and a backup if Ekko and Katarina are banned.

roles.tip: Mid is where we can break them. Shove, then roam to bot river with HennenG. Smette's first gank comes mid.

roles.about: Master 640 LP. Prime League: Kalista 2-0, Ashe 2-0, Varus 2-4, Jinx 1-1, Kai'Sa 1-1. Mastery: Jinx 1.02M, Kalista 691k.

picks.why: EP's most played ADC. Outranges Varus, Jinx and Kalista in lane. Pro pick (13 LEC Summer games).
Joint most picked ADC of the LEC Summer playoffs (with Ashe). Safest into their engage supports, and poke for the scaling plan.
Most banned champ in LCK and LEC Spring 2026. Take it if open: it's Don's most played Prime League pick (though 2-4).

roles.tip: Their bot lane is their strongest duo (two Master players). Don't fight level 2 if they hit it first. Rell, Nautilus and Leona all go in on it.

roles.about: Master 1,071 LP, the highest-ranked player in this game. Prime League: Nautilus 2-1, Nami 2-1, Braum 2-0, Lulu 1-1, Rell 0-2. Solo queue: Rell (14 of 30 games).

picks.why: 3-0 for HennenG in Prime League. Point-and-click engage on their immobile mid and ADC.
HennenG's most played (11 ranked games, 7 wins). LEC Summer's most picked support.
Counter to their engage (Rell, Nautilus, Jarvan ult). Fits the scaling comp.
3-1 for HennenG in Prime League. Cleanses Nautilus and Rell CC, great with Ezreal or Caitlyn.

roles.tip: Hold a ward in tri-brush for their level 2. After the first back, roam mid with Heino: that's the lane we win.

comps.name: A · Dive & catch
comps.win: Catch their immobile mid or ADC: Nautilus or Wukong engage, Shen ults in, Ekko cleans up. Take drakes when Caitlyn has lane prio.
comps.why: Wukong 3-0 and Nautilus 3-0 in our Prime League games, Ekko 6-0 in ranked, Caitlyn is EP's most played ADC.
comps.risk: Weak into Braum/Anivia peel, and it falls off if we get no early lead.

comps.name: B · Scale & teamfight
comps.win: Survive lanes, trade objectives cross-map, fight at 3 items. They lose their long games.
comps.why: Braum blocks their engage, Trundle beats K'Sante and Ornn, Viego is Smette's main, Ahri and Ezreal are safe against their skirmish.
comps.risk: Gives up early drakes. Needs patience and vision.

comps.name: C · LEC meta wombo
comps.sub: pro picks that suit our players
comps.win: Chain CC: Leona + Lissandra + Xin knock-up, then Rumble's Equalizer and Varus' ult on the stack.
comps.why: LEC 2026's most picked top (Rumble), jungle (Xin Zhao) and support (Leona), plus Varus, the most banned champ in LCK and LEC Spring 2026.
comps.risk: Rumble and Varus are often banned. Kolbe and EP need reps on them.

plan.fearless: The three comps share no champions. If this game day is a series with Fearless Draft, play them in order (A, then B, then C).

blue: B1: Xin Zhao or Wukong for Smette, taking Flausch's next-best champion.
B2 + B3: bot pair after their first picks. Caitlyn + Nautilus into a scaling ADC, Ezreal + Braum into engage.
Phase-2 bans: Ruvex's remaining comfort (K'Sante / Ambessa) or Lord Steve's (Rell / Nami).
B4: Heino's mid, countering their mid if it's out.
red: R1 + R2: Smette's jungler and Heino's best open mid (Ekko or Ahri).
R3: HennenG's support, answering their bot lane.
Phase-2 bans: Ruvex's top (K'Sante / Ambessa) so he ends up on something worse.

points: Ward our jungle entrances by 1:15. Flausch loves level-3 skirmishes with Jarvan, Xin and Elise.
Bot respects level 2 against Rell, Nautilus and Leona; HennenG wards tri-brush.
Smette's first gank goes mid. WoFu is their lowest-ranked player and plays immobile mages.
Kolbe holds TP for drake fights. No river fights without mid prio.
Their best comp (Ornn, Xin, Anivia, Kalista, Braum) won twice in under 30 minutes off early drakes. If they get prio, trade cross-map instead of flipping.
One shotcaller for objectives, short calls ("Flausch bot", "Flash mid down").
This is our window: their losses average 36 minutes. Group, ward Baron early, fight front-to-back.
Don't split Heino alone. Their jungle and support punish picks.
